issues.description: Substring match in validate_conda accepts impostors whose --version output contains 'conda'/'mamba'.
issues.detail: any(tool in out.decode().lower() for tool in ['micromamba','mamba','conda']) admits any binary whose version text contains those substrings. Match on the executable basename or parse the leading token of the version output. The identity check should be exact, not substring soup.

issues.description: filters='*.exe' on the file picker breaks Linux and macOS users.
issues.detail: Conda/mamba/micromamba binaries on Unix have no .exe extension, so the dialog filter yields an empty picker on non-Windows platforms and leaks a Windows assumption through a cross-platform abstraction. Make the filter platform-conditional or drop it.

issues.description: validate_conda returns True for an empty string, lying about validity.
issues.detail: Returning True for '' conflates 'no input supplied' with 'valid executable', so callers expecting 'True implies usable conda' get a false positive. Either treat empty as a precondition violation handled by the UI, or return False and let the call site interpret unset state.

issues.description: setFocus() side effect added to shared create_browsefile helper changes behavior for every caller.
issues.detail: select_file in widgets/config.py now unconditionally calls edit.setFocus() after picking a file, altering focus behavior for every preference page using this helper. Move the setFocus call to the conda-specific caller, or gate it with an opt-in parameter.

issues.description: validate_conda swallows exceptions and leaks the subprocess on every keystroke.
issues.detail: The bare 'except Exception: return False' discards diagnostic info (timeout, permission, decode), and the Popen from run_program is never bound, waited on, or closed — over live validation in a text field this leaks descriptors. Log the failure reason and ensure the subprocess closes cleanly.

issues.description: Empty-string sentinel plus custom_conda boolean encodes the same state twice.
issues.detail: conda_path='' with a separate custom_conda flag duplicates the 'unset' state and forces validate_conda to special-case the empty case. A single Optional[str] (None means unset) would eliminate drift between the two fields and make the fallback chain in kernelspec self-evident.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the patch is well-scoped — a checkbox plus a path with discovery fallback — but ships sloppy validation and one cross-platform regression. validate_conda uses substring matching that admits impostors and returns True for empty input, while the file picker's '*.exe' filter breaks Linux and macOS users. Secondary issues: a setFocus side effect added to a shared widget helper affects every caller, the subprocess in validate_conda is leaked with exceptions silently swallowed, and the dual conda_path/custom_conda state is redundant. Verdict: needs-work — tighten the validator, platform-gate the filter, and move the focus call to the caller before landing.
